For your engineers

The whole brief, one call away

Ask from your own tools. Three lines of shell and I answer with the decision, the confidence and the evidence attached.

  1. 01Create a keyOne key per workspace, scoped read-only until you widen it.
  2. 02Ask a real questionPlain language in. I pull from every connected source before answering.
  3. 03Read the evidenceEach answer returns its confidence and the sources it stands on.
POST https://api.seekalfred.ai/v1/ask
